name: samsat-bandung-timur-bot
description: Telegram chatbot for SAMSAT Bandung Timur information on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.export:research:html: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export research html --output research.html
scripts.export:responses: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export responses csv --output research/responses.csv
scripts.export:responses:txt: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export responses txt --output research/responses.txt
scripts.export:responses:html: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export responses html --output research/responses.html
scripts.export:summary: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts summary txt --input research/responses.csv --output research/summary.txt
scripts.export:summary:html: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts summary html --input research/responses.csv --output research/summary.html
scripts.export:satisfaction:html: tsx tools/bot-admin.ts export satisfaction html --output satisfaction.html
